title: Exhibitions
intro: Exhibitions, festivals and public presentations featuring the photographic work of Beatriz Perez. For a full exhibition history, see the CV.

quote.text: The exhibition remains the primary place to encounter art.
quote.author: Jens Hoffmann, curator and writer, in Show Time, 2017 edition

items.title: Mujeres
items.subtitle: International Photography Exhibition, Paris Photo Off
items.text: ImageNation Paris 2025 at Galerie Joseph Le Palais in the Marais during Paris Photo 2025. Eight international photography exhibitions, including documentary, fine art portraiture and Polaroid, highlight the Latin American female gaze. Presented with the Fotógrafas LATAM collective.

items.title: SHAPE
items.subtitle: International Photography Exhibition
items.text: An international photography exhibition celebrating the rich tapestry of photographic creativity, from local talents to global visionaries.

items.title: Branches
items.subtitle: ECOFeminism Festival, 2nd edition
items.text: A festival to celebrate nature, women and their empowering connection. A selection of MISShapes was shown in the Branches exhibition.

items.title: TERRA
items.subtitle: Multimedia group exhibition
items.text: A multimedia group exhibition in support of our planet, featuring artists addressing climate change through their work: the beauty of nature and its destruction, upcycled materials and sustainable art practices.

items.title: The Divine Feminine
items.subtitle: Virtual exhibition
items.text: A virtual exhibition on sacred femininity and the strength found in softness, challenging society’s idea of what it means to be empowered.

items.title: Utopia
items.subtitle: ECOFeminism Festival
items.text: A festival to celebrate women, nature and their empowering connection.

items.title: Voices of Earth
items.subtitle: Virtual exhibition
items.text: An interdisciplinary group art exhibition celebrating life on Earth.

items.title: We Grow into the Forest
items.subtitle: Group exhibition
items.text: An interdisciplinary group art exhibition inspired by our relationship with nature.

items.title: Leytonstone Arts Trail
items.subtitle: Sources of Inspiration, 10th anniversary
items.text: The Sources of Inspiration exhibition, part of the Leytonstone Arts Trail’s 10th anniversary.

items.title: In Einem Fernen, Fernen Land
items.subtitle: Touring group exhibition
items.text: In a Country Far, Far Away travelled to the Fairy Tale and Legend Museum in Bad Oeynhausen, uniting cultures through stories.

items.title: In a Country Far, Far Away
items.subtitle: Cross-border group exhibition
items.text: A cross-border group exhibition inspired by fairy tales, myths and legends from countries in war and crisis.

items.title: Colour Assembly
items.subtitle: Pop-up exhibition
items.text: Contemporary artists address the subject of colour in a Camden pop-up exhibition.

items.title: Testbed: Market to Market
items.subtitle: Artists’ Studio salon
items.text: The Front of House team’s collaborative project: a series of interventions in local street markets, presented in the Artists’ Studio.

items.title: MAPS Degree Show
items.subtitle: MA Photographic Studies
items.text: 27 exhibitors from 17 countries, curated and designed by Dr Elizabeth Upper, University of Cambridge.

items.title: Renaissance Photography Prize
items.subtitle: Shortlisted, Disorientation category
items.text: An international photography competition raising money to support younger women with breast cancer.
